formal_definition: P=(Sigma,N,tau,L,w,T4,nu) fixes normalization, provenance transduction, explicit cycle annotations, zero-metric whitespace hinges, torus dimension 4 and target value 19.
bounds: Valid only inside the named profile; not standard font topology.

formal_definition: N lowercases, applies NFC and reduces every non-empty whitespace run to one separator while preserving separator count after normalization.
bounds: Positional cycle annotations require unchanged layout.

formal_definition: tau maps a->4, e->3, i->1, o->0 while retaining each source index and source symbol as cell provenance.
bounds: Finite versioned map; not a universal leet alphabet.

formal_definition: Each token of m symbols becomes a path with m edges and m+1 vertices; separate tokens begin as distinct components.
bounds: One-dimensional CW model only.

formal_definition: Each declared cycle position adds one loop 1-cell at the symbol anchor. The source and target records each declare exactly four positions.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Annotations are explicit data, not inferred glyph counters.

formal_definition: Each token boundary contributes one zero-metric loop edge at the right endpoint of the preceding token, tagged with the next token's entry vertex.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Pseudometric weight zero does not remove the topological cell.

formal_definition: For finite graph X, beta0 is the component count and beta1=E-V+beta0, with loop edges included.
bounds: Graph/CW complexes only.

formal_definition: chi(X)=V-E=beta0-beta1.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: No planar-renderer interpretation is imported.

formal_definition: Replace a loop edge (u,u) by a bridge (u,v) to a distinct component. V and E stay fixed; beta0 and beta1 both decrease by one; chi is conserved.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Requires v in a different component and an actual loop edge.

formal_definition: The traded separator becomes a bridge with metric weight 0. It joins components topologically while collapsing its metric length in the profile pseudometric.
bounds: Weighted algorithms must accept a pseudometric.

formal_definition: Apply the Space-Hole trade once per separator. For k tokens and h intrinsic cycles, (beta0,beta1)=(k,h+k-1) becomes (1,h) with chi=1-h throughout.
bounds: Separator adjacency must be a tree/order chain.

formal_definition: Collapse the canonical backbone/bridge spanning tree T, obtaining X/T homeomorphic to a wedge of beta1 circles.
bounds: The quotient, not the uncollapsed tree, is the immersion domain.

formal_definition: When beta1=4, order the four intrinsic loop edges by profile cycle index to obtain c1,...,c4 and H1(X/T;Z)=Z^4.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Reject if canonical beta1 is not exactly four.

formal_definition: Map cj(t) to the jth coordinate circle in T_syn^4=(R/Z)^4; all four cycle generators have winding vectors e_j.
bounds: Image is the union of four coordinate circles, not the full torus.

formal_definition: The induced H1 matrix is I4 and has rank 4.
bounds: Certifies generator alignment, not homeomorphism to T4.

formal_definition: Encode the two transduced strings in 8-bit ASCII.
bounds: ASCII only in the shipped witness.

formal_definition: Embed both byte strings in length n=max(lengths) by appending 0x00 to the shorter source.
bounds: Alignment and pad byte are part of the witness.

formal_definition: Delta=X xor Y in F2^(n x 8); applying the same Delta again inverts the affine translation.
bounds: This is bytewise XOR, not a shift instruction.

formal_definition: E_n=ker(p), p(Delta)=sum_ij Delta_ij mod 2. It has dimension 8n-1 for n>0.
bounds: Guarantees parity class, not Hamming weight.

formal_definition: The shipped affine subspace adds Delta_3=Delta_4 and Delta_7=Delta_8, reproducing masks 0x5d and 0x5e.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Zero-based row indices; pair constraints are profile-specific.

formal_definition: For Y=X+Delta, pi(Y)=pi(X)+p(Delta). Delta in E_n forces pi(Y)=pi(X).
bounds: One-bit global parity only.

formal_definition: x->x+Delta is a bijection. For any random variable X on the fixed-width code space, H(X+Delta)=H(X); an even Delta additionally keeps parity cosets invariant.
bounds: Does not assert equal empirical bit weight or physical entropy.

formal_definition: nu maps each declared representation ID to a finite real value; the shipped source and target both map to 19.
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: No external linguistic universality is inferred.

formal_definition: r~r' iff nu(r)=nu(r'). The quotient Q=R/~ is identified with im(nu) subset R.
bounds: Evaluator/profile must be declared.

formal_definition: For spatial samples p,q labeled by representations, d_nu(p,q)=|nu(lambda(p))-nu(lambda(q))|. It is a pseudometric on space and a metric on Q.
bounds: Distinct spatial points in one semantic fiber may have distance zero.

formal_definition: F_19(p)=nu(lambda(p))-19 and Z_19=F_19^-1(0). Under d_nu, |F_19(p)|=dist_dnu(p,Z_19).
source_basis: source PDF pp.1-5; course-correction profile prompt
bounds: Exact only in the semantic quotient/pullback metric, not Euclidean rendering space.

formal_definition: g_epsilon(r)=|nu(r)-19|-epsilon; commit when g_epsilon<=0 under ordinary UGTS support and compatibility gates.
bounds: epsilon must be finite and non-negative.

formal_definition: Record augmented/canonical Betti signatures, trade records, T4 homology certificates, XOR witness, parity/entropy scope, semantic quotient and explicit non-claims.
bounds: Certificate validity is profile-exact and non-transferable without profile identity.

formal_definition: After the BEA certificate, continue support -> compatibility -> guard -> verified event -> transition -> lineage.
bounds: BEA does not replace support or compatibility.

formal_definition: Mark this package as the course-corrected 3.6.1 edition and retain the earlier 3.6 baseline as provenance, while superseding the prior planar-glyph BEA interpretation.
bounds: Version remains 3.6.1; revision status must be explicit.
